evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; the growth stage needs a tube pressure gauge, so P is null throughout
Ramp tracked the setpoint; overshot to 760.2 at growth start, then settled at 750±1
Purge brought O2 down to about 5 ppm, and it stayed there through growth (no sign of a leak)
Flow held at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint
Heater power steady at about 44% while holding growth temperature

args.missing_evidence: No tube pressure reading exists, so an exhaust blockage or a pressure outside the recipe range can't be ruled out. Measuring tube pressure (a temporary gauge, or an operator checking the bubbler or exhaust) would settle it. Characterization of the sample is still to come.
